final: WITH rep_counts AS (SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.City, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM Customer c JOIN Employee e ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.City), above_average AS (SELECT EmployeeId, City, customer_count, customer_count - AVG(customer_count) OVER (PARTITION BY City) AS excess FROM rep_counts), kept AS (SELECT EmployeeId, City, customer_count, excess FROM above_average WHERE excess > 0), totals AS (SELECT SUM(customer_count) AS combined_count FROM kept) SELECT k.City, SUM(k.customer_count) AS total_customers, AVG(k.excess) AS average_excess, AVG(1.0 * k.customer_count / t.combined_count) AS average_share FROM kept k CROSS JOIN totals t GROUP BY k.City
